what_it_measures: Share of the image that is empty space (dark regions) large enough to see.
how_it_is_measured: Pixel counting on the segmented map (Delesse: area fraction = volume fraction).
high_value_warns: Low -> fewer channels for lithium; high can mean loose coating or pull-out artefacts.
caveat: Only pores above ~0.35 um are counted; true electrode porosity is typically 25-40 %.

what_it_measures: Resolved porosity plus a correction for pores too small to see.
how_it_is_measured: pore_frac_resolved + delta_lit (0.15-0.30 literature band). ASSUMED component — swept as uncertainty.
high_value_warns: Feeds electrolyte transport; treated as a range, not a point.
caveat: The delta is assumed from literature, not measured.

what_it_measures: Share of the image that is classified silicon particles.
how_it_is_measured: Area of si_particle objects / image area.
high_value_warns: High -> more swelling demand, more SEI surface.

what_it_measures: Bright pixels BEFORE the si_particle/bright_fine split — what naive thresholding would call silicon.
how_it_is_measured: Pixel counting on the raw bright phase.
high_value_warns: Compare with si_frac_total — a big gap means overcounting.

what_it_measures: Bright objects that failed the silicon test (edges, carbon-binder, fines).
high_value_warns: Elevated -> low-contrast photo overcounting Si; trust si_frac_total instead of the raw bright fraction.
caveat: Guard rail — not a physical phase claim.

what_it_measures: Share of the image that is grey bulk material.
how_it_is_measured: Pixel counting (binder has no BSE contrast — merged with graphite by design).
feeds_dfn_parameter: Primary: Negative electrode active material volume fraction

plain_name: Silicon share of the solid material
what_it_measures: Silicon area divided by all solid area (Si + graphite).
feeds_dfn_parameter: Secondary: Negative electrode active material volume fraction
high_value_warns: High -> greater lithiation swelling per unit coating.

what_it_measures: Number of silicon particles per million pixels.
high_value_warns: High -> finer Si distribution.

what_it_measures: Number of ambiguous bright objects per million pixels.
Small end of the silicon size distribution.
Typical silicon particle size counting every particle equally.
how_it_is_measured: Equivalent-circle diameter of each watershed-split si_particle; 50th percentile.
high_value_warns: Rising -> coarser Si grade.

what_it_measures: Large end of the size distribution counting all particles equally.
Particle size where most of the silicon *mass* lives.
high_value_warns: Rising -> coarser Si grade / worse cracking risk.

what_it_measures: Size of the large end of the silicon distribution.
high_value_warns: High -> large-particle tail; crack/pulverization risk.

what_it_measures: Average size where the silicon mass sits.
Biggest silicon particle fully inside the frame.
how_it_is_measured: Max equivalent diameter of non-border objects.
high_value_warns: Very large -> single-particle cracking hazard.

plain_name: Si area share in particles > 3 um
what_it_measures: How much silicon sits in large particles.
how_it_is_measured: Area-weighted tail of the size distribution.
high_value_warns: High -> larger fraction at cracking risk on lithiation.

plain_name: Si area share in particles > 5 um
what_it_measures: How much silicon sits in very large particles.
how_it_is_measured: Area-weighted tail of the size distribution.
high_value_warns: High -> severe cracking/pulverization risk.

what_it_measures: Sphere-equivalent radius corrected for slice bias.
high_value_warns: Feeds lithium diffusion length inside Si.

what_it_measures: How solid/compact the silicon particles are (1 = smooth convex).
high_value_warns: Low -> jagged particles; sphere assumption degrades.

what_it_measures: Mean major/minor axis ratio of silicon particles.
high_value_warns: High -> elongated particles; sphere assumption degrades.

what_it_measures: How clumped silicon particles are (R<1 clumped, R~1 random, R>1 evenly spaced).
how_it_is_measured: Nearest-neighbour distance vs random expectation, Donnelly edge-corrected.
high_value_warns: Low -> clusters swell as one big particle -> local stress.

what_it_measures: Mean distance to the closest silicon particle.
how_it_is_measured: KD-tree nearest neighbour on particle centroids.
high_value_warns: Low -> tight packing.

what_it_measures: How unevenly silicon is distributed across the image.
how_it_is_measured: CV of Si fraction across 6 vertical strips.
high_value_warns: High -> mixing/dispersion problem.

what_it_measures: Share of Si boundary within ~75 nm of a pore.
how_it_is_measured: 3-px dilation contact band (1-px test is degenerate here — Si sits ~0.6 um away).
high_value_warns: Low -> silicon isolated from electrolyte.

what_it_measures: How far silicon boundaries sit from the nearest pore.
how_it_is_measured: Distance transform from pore mask over Si boundary pixels.
high_value_warns: High -> silicon far from electrolyte -> poorly wetted, dead capacity.

what_it_measures: Share of silicon particles with zero pore contact.
high_value_warns: High -> much silicon is electrochemically isolated.
caveat: Runs high (~0.7-0.99) in every image — relative comparison only.

plain_name: Si boundary coverage by pores, mean
what_it_measures: Mean share of each silicon particle's boundary within ~75 nm of a pore.
high_value_warns: Low -> silicon poorly wetted by electrolyte.

what_it_measures: Coverage of the least-connected silicon particles.
high_value_warns: Near 0 -> a real tail of isolated silicon exists.

what_it_measures: Share of silicon particles with <5% of their boundary near a pore — effectively isolated.
how_it_is_measured: Share of objects below the coverage cutoff.
high_value_warns: High -> substantial dead silicon.

what_it_measures: Share of silicon within reach of a pore.
high_value_warns: Low -> much of the silicon may be inactive.

what_it_measures: Silicon boundary exposed to the rest of the coating, per unit volume.
how_it_is_measured: Crofton stereology: S_V = transitions * px / area.
high_value_warns: High -> more Si-electrolyte contact -> more SEI growth.

what_it_measures: Bulk material boundary exposed to pores, per unit volume.
Sphere-equivalent radius giving the measured surface-to-volume ratio.
high_value_warns: Feeds lithium diffusion length inside graphite.
caveat: Flakes are not spheres — diffusion-equivalent approximation.

what_it_measures: Mean horizontal vs vertical chord through bulk; >1 = flakes lie flat.
high_value_warns: High -> strong layering -> anisotropic ion/electron paths.

what_it_measures: Typical size of visible pores.
how_it_is_measured: Median equivalent-circle diameter of pore objects.

what_it_measures: Number of pore objects per million pixels.
high_value_warns: High -> more fragmented pore network or finer pores.

what_it_measures: Area share of very large holes (>0.5 % of image).
how_it_is_measured: Pore objects above the large-void area cutoff.
high_value_warns: High -> manufacturing voids / contamination damage.

what_it_measures: Area share of elongated pores lying along the foil.
how_it_is_measured: Pore objects with aspect > 3 within 30 deg of foil.
high_value_warns: High -> delamination-type damage.

what_it_measures: Area share of elongated pores pointing across the coating (tearing signature).
how_it_is_measured: Pore objects with aspect > 3 oriented > 30 deg from foil.
high_value_warns: High -> mechanical tears; also express ion lanes.

what_it_measures: Area share of compact, non-elongated pores (control metric).
high_value_warns: Stable value = segmentation behaving normally.

what_it_measures: How upright the pore area is overall (1 = vertical).
how_it_is_measured: Area-weighted |sin(angle vs foil)| over pore objects.
high_value_warns: Low -> pores lie flat -> longer ion path.

what_it_measures: Mean uninterrupted pore run along image rows.
Mean uninterrupted pore run along image columns.
>1 means pores lie flat along the foil.
how_it_is_measured: Horizontal / vertical chord ratio on the pore mask.
high_value_warns: High -> flat pores lengthen the through-plane ion path -> plating risk at fast charge.

what_it_measures: How much longer a path through the pore network is than a straight line, top-to-bottom.
how_it_is_measured: Geodesic (maze-solving) distance through pores vs straight depth.
high_value_warns: High -> sluggish ion transport through thickness.
caveat: Image top is NOT the separator (edges unknown) — use the anisotropy ratio, not the absolute.

what_it_measures: Same measure along the in-plane direction.
Directional penalty of the pore network.
high_value_warns: High -> ions detour much more through-thickness than in-plane -> plating risk.

what_it_measures: Fraction of pore pixels connected to the top edge through the pore network.
how_it_is_measured: Geodesic flood from the edge; connected share.
high_value_warns: Low -> dead-end pores carry no ions.
caveat: 2D proxy only — true connectivity is 3D (needs tomography or the bonus reconstruction branch).

what_it_measures: Biggest connected pore blob as a share of all pore pixels.
how_it_is_measured: Connected components on the pore mask.
high_value_warns: Low -> fragmented pore network.

what_it_measures: Tortuosity-porosity exponent implied by the measured tau proxy.
how_it_is_measured: b = 1 - ln(tau) / ln(eps), clipped to [1, 3]; default 1.5 if degenerate.
high_value_warns: High -> steeper transport penalty as porosity drops.
caveat: Heuristic calibration — replaced by TauFactor tau_z if the 3D bonus branch runs.

what_it_measures: Characteristic size of pore regions.
Characteristic size of graphite domains.
Characteristic spacing/size of silicon regions.
Dark end of the raw histogram.
Middle of the raw histogram.
Bright end of the raw histogram.
How much brighter silicon is than bulk, normalised to the pore-bulk gap.
high_value_warns: Low (~<1.9 here) -> low-contrast photo; Si may be overcounted (see bright_fine_frac).
caveat: Guard rail, not a material property.

what_it_measures: Pixel noise on bulk material.
high_value_warns: High -> segmentation less reliable.

what_it_measures: Focus quality (variance of Laplacian on bulk).
high_value_warns: Low -> blurry photo.

what_it_measures: Brightness drift across the frame.
how_it_is_measured: Linear slope of the row-median of bulk pixels.
high_value_warns: Strong -> uneven illumination left over.

what_it_measures: Secondary-electron image exists for this location.
Secondary detector image exists.
How much the measured porosity could differ just because the image is finite.
how_it_is_measured: 95% CI half-width across a 5x5 tile jackknife.

what_it_measures: Same finite-image uncertainty for the silicon fraction.
how_it_is_measured: 95% CI half-width across a 5x5 tile jackknife.

what_it_measures: Low-contrast photo where Si may be overcounted.
how_it_is_measured: si_bulk_contrast below the pooled 5th percentile across all images.
high_value_warns: Treat this photo's Si-derived markers with care; results reported with and without problem photos.
